locked_principles: Liquid Glass remains two-door only: Live Pulse and Narratives.
Roadmap governance appears as L5 executive/governance output, not as a third Arrival door.
All financial truth, audit evidence, formulas, and dense operating proof remain solid surfaces.
No roadmap item may bypass source lineage, RBAC, no-silent-fallback, or signed rollout gates.
Entity Head remains removed from role model.

quarters.executive_question: Can leadership trust SCIP every day?
Can SCIP make better decisions, not just faster ones?
Can SCIP scale beyond workbook-first operations?

items.title: Stabilize production launch and source-refresh governance
items.strategic_objective: Make SCIP trusted for daily leadership and operations use immediately after launch.
items.success_metric: 95%+ critical source freshness SLA for R18/R04/R02/R08/R36 and account-action sources; zero silent fallback incidents.
items.rollout_gate: UAT signoff, production smoke, identity provisioning, RBAC verification, backup/restore check.
items.risk: Users lose trust if source freshness or lineage is unclear during first month.
items.dependency: Batch 14 signoff, Batch 12 alerts, production source owners.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Disable new operational action surfaces and revert to read-only executive pulse if any critical source lacks lineage for more than one refresh cycle.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Expose health as L5 evidence from Live Pulse Risk & Action; do not add a health dashboard at Arrival.

items.title: Quickball answer-quality review loop
items.strategic_objective: Ensure every explanation remains lineage-backed and board-safe.
items.success_metric: 100% sampled critical answers carry source, sheet/range, confidence, and reporting basis; blocked-answer false positives reviewed monthly.
items.rollout_gate: Monthly model/answer review pack approved by change-control board.
items.risk: Quickball becomes a workaround for unclear screens or overexplains without evidence.
items.dependency: Lineage registry, Quickball review cadence, adoption telemetry.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Disable affected Quickball intents if any sampled answer uses unlineaged financial data.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Quickball remains a contextual command capsule with max two follow-up actions.

items.title: Metric definition catalogue and change-log hardening
items.strategic_objective: Prevent ambiguity between Finance, MDO, R08, R36, workflow, and adoption metrics.
items.success_metric: 100% critical metrics have owner, formula, source basis, reporting basis, and change history.
items.rollout_gate: Metric change-control approval before release train cut.
items.risk: Leadership decisions may be challenged if target basis or formula changes are not explicit.
items.dependency: Metric catalogue, source owner SLAs, finance signoff.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Revert metric definition and publish release note if signoff is missing or user-visible values materially change without approved basis.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Metric definitions remain L4 evidence; not visible on Arrival or L1.

items.title: Enterprise data warehouse alignment blueprint
items.strategic_objective: Move from workbook-first ingestion toward governed enterprise source alignment without breaking current R-series trust.
items.success_metric: Approved canonical fact/dimension model and source-to-DW mapping for collections, OD, target, advance, workflow, and audit facts.
items.rollout_gate: Architecture review, data owner approval, pilot reconciliation against current adapters.
items.risk: Premature DW migration could break trusted workbook reconciliation.
items.dependency: Enterprise warehouse access, source system owners, reconciliation harness.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Keep workbook adapters as source of truth until DW facts reconcile within 0.05% tolerance and lineage parity is achieved.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: DW alignment is backend governance; no user-facing IA change.

items.title: Collector/RM action queue adoption scale-up
items.strategic_objective: Convert lineaged account actions into measurable collections follow-through.
items.success_metric: 70%+ eligible collector actions dispositioned within SLA; workflow closure rate improves month over month.
items.rollout_gate: Pilot results, role-level RBAC confirmation, collector training signoff.
items.risk: Collectors may treat SCIP as monitoring rather than help if actions are noisy.
items.dependency: R10/R32/R34 freshness, notification tuning, collector scope provisioning.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Disable noisy queue rules if false-positive action rate exceeds agreed threshold for two consecutive review cycles.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Action queues remain Risk & Action L5 output; no collector table on Arrival.

items.title: Escalation operating rhythm for overdue, stale, and high-risk workflows
items.strategic_objective: Create a repeatable management cadence for resolving overdue/high-risk action pools.
items.success_metric: Stale workflow rate reduced by 30%; unassigned high-risk actions remain below threshold.
items.rollout_gate: Weekly management review evidence pack and escalation acceptance criteria.
items.risk: Too many escalations create alert fatigue and reduce operational credibility.
items.dependency: Notification suppression rules, owner mappings, workflow event quality.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Suppress or lower priority of escalation rule if duplicate/suppressed ratio exceeds governance threshold.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Escalations surface through Risk & Action, not as separate escalation dashboard.

items.title: Finance/QCG exception closure program
items.strategic_objective: Reduce PR, SOA, TAT, and documentation leakage that blocks cash recognition or customer action.
items.success_metric: PR/TAT ageing exceptions reduced by 25%; closure reasons complete for 95%+ resolved finance exceptions.
items.rollout_gate: Finance UAT, QCG owner signoff, audit export review.
items.risk: Process exceptions may be misclassified as collector issues.
items.dependency: R31/R20 freshness, finance workflow roles, process ageing rules.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Reclassify queue rules and pause notifications if finance exception owner mapping accuracy drops below threshold.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Finance exceptions remain solid evidence/timeline surfaces.

items.title: Risk scoring v2 and forecast confidence bands
items.strategic_objective: Move beyond static action priority into risk-adjusted intervention and forecast confidence.
items.success_metric: Risk score v2 explains priority drivers and improves high-risk closure conversion versus baseline.
items.rollout_gate: Model review, back-test evidence, Quickball explanation review, rollback rule approved.
items.risk: Model opacity could reduce trust or create unfair collector prioritization.
items.dependency: Historical closure data, R38 quality, workflow outcome labels.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Revert to rule-based queues if model explanations are incomplete or performance does not beat baseline.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Model score explanations are L4 evidence, not decorative signal chips.

items.title: Executive narrative and board pack generation
items.strategic_objective: Reduce board-preparation effort while improving evidence-backed storytelling.
items.success_metric: Board pack preparation time reduced by 50%; 100% board narrative claims trace to approved lineage.
items.rollout_gate: Executive review, legal/audit approval for export contents, presentation smoke.
items.risk: Narratives may over-summarize operational complexity or omit important caveats.
items.dependency: Narratives evidence templates, export controls, source freshness.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Disable auto-generated board pack export if any claim lacks lineage or approved caveat.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Present remains an output action, never a browsing mode.

items.title: Self-serve evidence catalogue for definitions, formulas, and source basis
items.strategic_objective: Let users verify numbers without exposing raw architecture too early.
items.success_metric: 80%+ repeated “source basis” questions resolved through evidence paths rather than manual MIS support.
items.rollout_gate: Evidence template QA, RBAC review, metric owner approval.
items.risk: Evidence catalogue could become a raw data dump if not gated.
items.dependency: Metric catalogue, lineage registry, RBAC evidence visibility.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Hide overly dense evidence templates until simplified if users bypass focus screens or support tickets rise.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Evidence appears only after explicit L4 intent.

items.title: Source-system and warehouse integration pilot
items.strategic_objective: Start replacing manual R-series refresh dependency with governed enterprise pipelines.
items.success_metric: At least two critical domains run from enterprise pipeline in parallel and reconcile against R-series within 0.05% tolerance.
items.rollout_gate: Parallel-run signoff, rollback plan, source owner approval, data contract acceptance.
items.risk: New pipeline changes numbers without user-visible source-basis clarity.
items.dependency: DW access, source APIs, reconciliation test harness.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Fallback to workbook adapter for any domain with failed reconciliation or missing lineage parity.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: No user-facing route change; only source-basis and freshness labels change after approval.

items.title: Enterprise hierarchy and master-data stewardship
items.strategic_objective: Make entity/project/customer/collector mappings durable across platforms and reporting cycles.
items.success_metric: 100% critical action rows have entity, project, owner, and scope mapping; mapping exception backlog below SLA.
items.rollout_gate: Data governance board approval and mapping exception review.
items.risk: Mis-mapped owner/entity scopes can break RBAC or action ownership.
items.dependency: IdP groups, collector mappings, project master, customer/unit master.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Block action generation for mapping segments with unresolved ownership ambiguity.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Master data exceptions are governance evidence, not a user-facing filter-first experience.

items.title: Mobile-first collector action experience pilot
items.strategic_objective: Bring focused, role-safe actions to collectors without exposing executive or audit complexity.
items.success_metric: Collector daily active use reaches target; disposition completion time improves without increasing false closures.
items.rollout_gate: Pilot cohort signoff, security review, mobile UX test, notification policy approval.
items.risk: Mobile experience can become a mini-dashboard instead of an action aid.
items.dependency: SSO/session behavior, RBAC row scope, workflow API stability.
items.rollback_exit_criteria: Restrict mobile to read-only action reminders if closure quality or RBAC test fails.
items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Mobile is action-first; no KPI grid or operational dashboard at entry.
